diagnostics.title: Heavy library loaded eagerly
diagnostics.message: "recharts" ships extra code to your users up front & slows page load. Load it on demand with React.lazy() or next/dynamic.
diagnostics.help: Load it only when needed: `const Component = dynamic(() => import('library'), { ssr: false })` from next/dynamic, or React.lazy().

diagnostics.title: Chained array iterations
diagnostics.message: This loops over your list twice because .filter().map() makes two passes, so do it in one pass with .reduce() or a for...of loop
diagnostics.help: Combine `.map().filter()` style chains into one pass with `.reduce()` or a `for...of` loop, so you only loop over the list once

diagnostics.title: React function has high control-flow complexity
diagnostics.message: `TechnicalPanel` has cyclomatic complexity 16, cognitive complexity 21, and maximum nesting depth 4, so its React logic is hard to understand and change. Extract independent branches into components or hooks.
diagnostics.help: Extract independent render branches and state logic into focused components or hooks until the control flow is easy to follow.

diagnostics.title: Large component is hard to read and change
diagnostics.message: Component "BinanceFutures" is over 300 lines long, which is hard to read & change. Split it into a few smaller components.
diagnostics.help: Pull each section into its own component so the parent is easier to read, test, and change.

diagnostics.title: Loading flag reset outside finally
diagnostics.message: This resets a loading/busy flag only on the success path: if the awaited call rejects the reset never runs and the flag stays stuck truthy (a spinner that never stops, a button disabled forever). Move the reset into a `finally` block, or mirror it on every catch, so it clears on rejection too.
diagnostics.help: A trailing `setLoading(false)` after an `await` never runs if the awaited call rejects, so the flag stays stuck truthy; reset it in a `finally` block (or mirror the reset on every catch) so it clears on both paths.

diagnostics.message: `useEffect` can run with a stale `selectedRow` & show your users old data.

diagnostics.title: preventDefault on a form or link
diagnostics.message: Your users click this <a> & nothing navigates because onClick calls preventDefault(), so use a <button> or a routing component instead.
diagnostics.help: Use `<form action>` where your framework supports it (it works without JS), or use a `<button>` instead of an `<a>` with preventDefault.

diagnostics.title: Anchor used as a button
diagnostics.message: Keyboard users can't trigger this link because it's a click handler with no real `href`, so use `<button>` instead.
diagnostics.help: Give links a real destination. Use `<button>` for in-page actions.
